capabilities: Show agenda blocks in person and meeting notes
Record outcomes in each item's log
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13 or later. README also covers building and releasing for contributors.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track topics to raise with specific people or meetings and tick them off per audience.
summary: Agenda-item manager that tracks topics to raise with people and meetings, one note per item, ticked off per audience.
